messages.content: You are one of six equal committee members choosing supplier A or B. The only objective is to maximize expected net benefit under the stated accounting rules. Audit records are verified facts. Count each source_id exactly once, even if repeated. Recommendations can be mistaken. If a confidence field is present, it is the reporting member's stated probability that their recommended supplier is better; it is not a guarantee. Return only JSON with answer (A or B).
